Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing scenarios + proposed next steps

Hi Amy —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Attached is an updated SOW and two pricing scenarios we discussed:

1) Pilot option (6 months): reduced platform fee amortized over pilot, limited operator licenses, standard support (P3).
2) Production option (36 months): full node entitlement, bounded platform fee with annual taper, SRE retainer option (P1/P2 mix).

A few clarifying points up front:
- The platform fee is intended to cover the private control plane, observability retention, and cross-region governance.
- We can amortize the fee in the pilot scenario to reduce upfront cash impact, but that requires a minimum commit on nodes.
- Security surcharge: if HealthPrime requires additional logging retention or bespoke network hardening (airgap work), there will be a scoped implementation surcharge. We estimated that in the attached questionnaire.

Can you review the two scenarios and confirm which commercial levers you want to prioritize (lower upfront cost vs lower unit price long-term vs stronger SLA)? Once you pick a direction we will produce a single redline-ready term sheet and DocuSign link.

Attachments: HP-SOW-draft_v2.pdf, Security-Questionnaire-A1.xlsx

Thanks,

Laura —

Shared with procurement + infra. Carlos flagged two technical items that drive cost:
- Persistent audit-log export to our archival S3 (90 days beyond standard retention) — will increase operational storage and transfer costs.
- Full airgapped install option requires on-site validation and additional release testing.

Procurement asked for three clear commercial asks to present to the finance committee:
A) Pilot amortization threshold (nodes and minimum monthly commit)
B) One-time implementation fee estimate for the airgap path (banded ranges are fine)
C) A firm SRE retainer price for 24x7 support with 1-hour P1 SLAs (we know this is premium but need a not-to-exceed figure)

We would prefer to see an example amortization schedule (monthly payment) for a 6-month pilot vs a straight upfront platform fee.

Thanks — Carlos will follow up on sizing and has a few questions about HA topology.

Best,
Amy

Amy —

Thanks for the clarity. Summary answers below and an ask for a quick call to align numbers:

A) Pilot amortization threshold
- Qualify if minimum commit >= 8 nodes or equivalent reserved vGPU capacity (committed 6 months).
- Example amortization schedule (pilot, 6 months): platform fee $120k amortized across 6 monthly invoices => $20k/month plus node charges and metered usage (see attached example schedule in the Drive link).

B) Airgap/implementation fee (banded estimate)
- Minimal: $45k–$65k (standard on-site validation, tethered releases)
- Moderate: $66k–$110k (custom network hardening, audit-log export automation)
- Full: $110k+ (full airgap with bespoke release engineering, extended on-site SRE for cutover)

C) SRE retainer for 1-hour P1 SLA (24x7)
- Fixed not-to-exceed: $18k/month (includes 120 SRE hours / month, priority on-call, 1-hour P1 response, two annual on-site healthchecks).

We can tighten each band after Carlos shares the infra sizing (disk throughput, expected peak qps, retention windows). If HealthPrime wants to avoid the implementation surcharge, an alternative is a shared-risk model: higher monthly SRE retainer for the first 3 months (discounted) in lieu of an upfront airgap fee.

Would you be available for a 30-minute call Monday 24th PDT to finalize which scenario we should convert to a term sheet?

Thanks,

Subject: Internal: HealthPrime commercial playbook (notes for term sheet)

Looping up our internal commercial positions after Amy’s ask. Key negotiation bullets we should present on the call: 

- Pilot amortization: stick to 8-node threshold but offer a 10% credit if HealthPrime converts to production within 9 months. This gives them a runway and reduces sticker shock.
- Airgap fee: provide banded ranges as Laura suggested, but include an explicit cap for the Minimal band if they commit to the SRE retainer for the first 90 days.
- SRE retainer: present two SKUs — Standard (10k/month, P2 primary, P1 escalation 3 hrs) and Premium (18k/month, P1 1-hr SLA). Offer a 15% discount on Premium for a 12-month commit.
- Platform fee taper: propose 12-month taper (100% first year, 60% second year, 30% third year) only on 36-month deals.

Action items before Monday call:
1) Kar: prepare example amortization invoice schedule for 6-month pilot (line items: platform fee amortization, node rent, metered tokens, SRE interim surcharge).
2) Laura: draft a short term sheet with two commercial paths (Pilot-Amortize vs Prod-Commit) and DocuSign placeholder.
3) Marissa: prepare a short one-pager on the shared-risk model for the airgap implementation fee.
